title: NCAA: ‘Missing piece’ Sison-Walker helping Letran elevate ceiling, says Ricardo
summary: Denzil Sison-Walker has wasted little time making his presence felt for Colegio de San Juan de Letran, helping the Knights address a key need as they opened NCAA Season 102 with back-to-back wins.
